card.name: Linking words before patient conditions or meds
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'of', 'if', 'knows' or 'active' right after 'worsening', 'unmasking', 'notify your physician' or 'have no', in patient-instruction and warning text.

modes.label: 'of' after worsening
modes.description: The word 'of' follows 'worsening' or 'unmasking' in warnings about a condition getting worse.
modes.example: should be monitored regularly for worsening<< of>> glucose control.

modes.label: After notify or tell
modes.description: A linking word or verb follows 'notify your physician' or 'be sure your provider' before a list of what to report.
modes.example: - Notify your physician<< if>> you are pregnant or suspect you may be

modes.label: After 'have no'
modes.description: The word 'active' follows 'have no' in eligibility lists.
modes.example: Candidates must be in good health, have no<< active>> diseases or serious, pre-existing medical conditions

card.plain: It marks the small word that comes before a named condition or medication in patient warnings and instructions.
